data.name: MWM_001
data.value: This wind is relentless...[pause=15] We must be really high up now.

data.name: MWM_002
data.value: Hey...[pause=10] did you feel that? The ground shook.

data.name: MWM_003
data.value: A rockslide!

data.name: MWM_004
data.value: A Gligar burst out of the wall!

data.name: MWM_005
data.value: A Skarmory dive-bombing![pause=10] There's two of them!

data.name: MWM_006
data.value: The Sentinels of the Peak...

data.name: MWM_007
data.value: You again![pause=10] Who are you?!

data.name: MWM_008
data.value: One commands the earth, the other the skies.[pause=20] Together, they are nearly invincible.

data.name: MWM_009
data.value: But every sentinel has its weakness...[pause=20] Find it.

data.name: MWM_010
data.value: We'll show them what we're made of![pause=10] Attack!

data.name: MWM_011
data.value: We're not giving up.[pause=15] This time, we break through!

data.name: MWM_012
data.value: We got the upper hand![pause=10] Those two won't stop us anymore.

data.name: MWM_013
data.value: That voice...[pause=15] You think it gave us a hint?

data.name: MWM_014
data.value: Maybe.[pause=20] Or maybe it just wants to see us succeed.

data.name: MWM_015
data.value: The sentinels pushed you back...

data.name: MWM_016
data.value: Learn from this defeat.[pause=30] The summit awaits only the strongest.

data.name: MWM_017
data.value: It's...[pause=10] it's too much for us![pause=15] We have to go back down!

data.name: MWM_018
data.value: Gligar snaps its claws, triumphant.[pause=10] Skarmory hovers above you,[pause=5] menacing.

data.name: MWM_019
data.value: The peaks are not for the weak.[pause=20] Go back down. Come back stronger.

data.name: MWM_020
data.value: They rise back into the updrafts,[pause=15] their silhouettes melting into the clouds.

data.name: MWM_021
data.value: Skarmory crashes to the ground with a metallic clang.[pause=10] Gligar retreats,[pause=5] wings folded.

data.name: MWM_022
data.value: Gligar gives you one last look before taking off.[pause=20] A look that says everything.

data.name: MWM_023
data.value: You...[pause=15] you've earned the right to climb higher.[pause=20] Don't disappoint us.

data.name: MWM_024
data.value: They disappear into the wind,[pause=10] leaving the path to the summit clear.

data.name: MWM_025
data.value: We got them![pause=10] Not even the wind could stop us!

data.name: MWM_026
data.value: The sentinels recognize strength.[pause=20] You earn their respect.

data.name: MWM_027
data.value: The sky has its guardians. Prove you deserve the summit.

data.name: MWM_028
data.value: The summit is close. What we've felt since we set out... it's up there.

data.name: MWM_029
data.value: The air is thin up here. Everything takes twice the effort.

data.name: MWM_030
data.value: One on the rock, one in the sky. They've done this before.

data.name: MWM_031
data.value: Many have climbed. Few have been allowed to finish.

data.name: MWM_032
data.value: Allowed by whom, exactly?

data.name: MWM_033
data.value: ...It never answers that one.

data.name: MWM_034
data.value: Then we climb without permission.

data.name: MWM_035
data.value: Watch the sky one, not the ground one. The sky one decides.

data.name: MWM_036
data.value: They draw back to the cliff edge and let the wind carry them off.

data.name: MWM_037
data.value: They could have kept fighting. They chose not to.

data.name: MWM_038
data.value: Two climbers.[pause=20] Unregistered.[pause=25] Turn back.

data.name: MWM_039
data.value: They won't, you know.[pause=20] They never do.

data.name: MWM_040
data.value: Forty-one have passed this ledge since the wind changed.

data.name: MWM_041
data.value: Nine came down again.[pause=30] I stopped counting after that.

data.name: MWM_042
data.value: We are not here to stop you.[pause=25] We are here to make it EXPENSIVE.

data.name: MWM_043
data.value: The ones who pay the price up here[pause=20] tend to survive what's above.

data.name: MWM_044
data.value: Paid.[pause=30] In full.

data.name: MWM_045
data.value: Register them, then.

data.name: MWM_046
data.value: Two climbers.[pause=25] Names unknown.[pause=20] Went up together.

data.name: MWM_047
data.value: Write that last part twice.[pause=30] It's the part that matters.
